mainEntity.name: What are structured group workouts at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Structured group workouts at Cave Training are instructor-led fitness sessions designed for multiple participants, focusing on functional movements that build strength, endurance, and mobility. These workouts follow a planned curriculum, ensuring progressive challenge and varied exercises. Each session includes warm-up, skill development, the main workout (WOD), and cool-down. Understanding your current fitness level and goals before joining can help ensure you select the appropriate class intensity.
